d3_sensitivity.note: The headline improvement is inflated by deferred_decisions.md D3: C_fp (848.23) already contains one review cost (500.00), and the binary formula charges a second review on every flag, so each avoided false-positive escalation appears to save 848.23 when the friction-only saving is 348.23.
